summary: Retest of iteration_9 fixes on the public preview URL (frontend only). All requested items pass. /invite fresh load (about:blank then /invite#token=, 4 runs, dev StrictMode) never shows 'Security check failed'; invite-summary and invite-new-account-form render with the prefilled name. A changed hash (A->D->A) reloads the preview for the new token. A reload restores the preview from sessionStorage. A rotated old token (after resend) and a garbage token show invite-load-error 'This invitation link is not valid. Ask for a new invitation.'; a revoked token shows invite-ended 'withdrawn'. No 403/CSRF responses were seen. /app/centers/new?applicationId=<provisioned> shows new-center-already-provisioned with open-existing-center-link, which navigates to the center. Team: resend and revoke clear team-notice, and switching tabs clears it. An empty staff invite submit shows one message: 'Please add their full name, a valid email address, at least one role.' The root page lists TB-EM-002 and TB-EM-003/004 as IMPLEMENTED. Regression passes: platform login, the wrong-password error, forgot password (outbox link), then reset, then login with the new password, and /apply (validation summary, then submit gives reference APP-3JPNMT).

ui_bugs.issue: Sending a new staff invite while on the Invitations tab after a resend/revoke shows two success banners: the new team-notice ('Invitation sent to X') and the stale invitations-success ('A new link was sent to Y'). The Invitations msg state is not cleared when version changes or when onSent fires.
The subtitle stays 'Checking your invitation…' after the check has finished with invite-load-error or invite-ended. It should change, for example to 'We could not open this invitation'.

action_items: LOW: In the Team Invitations component, clear msg when the version prop changes (or when a new invite is sent), so only one success banner shows.
LOW: On /invite, update the AuthLayout subtitle when error or ended state is shown.
critical_code_review_comments: preToken() shares a single in-flight promise and clears it in finally, which is correct. The `current` flag in the InvitePage effect correctly drops stale StrictMode or hashchange results.

In dev StrictMode each /invite load sends 2 inspect calls (and each hashchange 1). The ignored results are harmless, but each load uses 2 of the 30-per-15-min public invitation rate limit in preview. Production builds are not affected.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested items (2 LOW cosmetic issues found)
